1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Locate one large hot sphere among one neutral solid. One hot slice and one registered probe view are enough before a forgiving extraction.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Find the large hot object with the X-ray controls, lock the surgery frame, and extract it without touching the one neutral solid.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Sweep the X-ray table directly to find the large hot object, lock the surgery frame, and extract it without touching the one neutral solid. Horizontal drags sweep X; vertical drags sweep Z; drag the lower Y-depth rail horizontally to sweep Y.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Locate a large hot sphere among two neutral solids. Separated slices from two suitcase orientations and two probe views establish the surgery path.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Use separated X-ray slices from two suitcase orientations, then register the probe in two views and extract the hot object cleanly.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Use direct X-ray sweeps from two suitcase orientations, then register the probe in two views and extract the hot object cleanly. Horizontal drags sweep X; vertical drags sweep Z; drag the lower Y-depth rail horizontally to sweep Y.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Historical four-volume configuration retained exactly: four observations, two suitcase orientations, a 1.0 plane span, two hot target observations, and two registered probe views.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Locate and extract the marked contraband without damaging any innocent object. Collect separated X-ray slices across multiple rigid suitcase orientations, lock the surgery frame, register the probe across orthogonal views, capture the target geometrically, and withdraw it cleanly.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Locate and extract the marked contraband without damaging any innocent object. Directly sweep separated X-ray slices across multiple rigid suitcase orientations, lock the surgery frame, register the probe across orthogonal views, capture the target geometrically, and withdraw it cleanly. Horizontal drags sweep X; vertical drags sweep Z; drag the lower Y-depth rail horizontally to sweep Y; drag the case handle to rotate.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Reconstruct the four-volume scene with hot target evidence in two distinct suitcase orientations, then move the probe in both orthogonal views before a clean extraction.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Collect hot X-ray observations in two different suitcase orientations, lock the surgery frame, move the probe in both orthogonal views to register it, then capture and withdraw the target without damage.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Directly collect hot X-ray observations in two different suitcase orientations, lock the surgery frame, move the probe in both orthogonal views to register it, then capture and withdraw the target without damage. Horizontal drags sweep X; vertical drags sweep Z; drag the lower Y-depth rail horizontally to sweep Y; drag the case handle to rotate.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Reconstruct a smaller hot sphere among five neutral solids. Three hot slices across three orientations, six total slices, and meaningful probe movement in all three views are required before a tighter clean extraction.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Collect a hot slice in each of three suitcase orientations, lock the surgery frame, move the probe in all three views to register it, and extract the smaller target without damage.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Directly collect a hot slice in each of three suitcase orientations, lock the surgery frame, move the probe in all three views to register it, and extract the smaller target without damage. Horizontal drags sweep X; vertical drags sweep Z; drag the lower Y-depth rail horizontally to sweep Y; drag the case handle to rotate.

simplified.summary: Choose X-ray axes, step the plane, and quarter-turn the suitcase with labelled controls; keep direct orthogonal probe dragging.

full.summary: Sweep X and Z directly on the scan surface, sweep Y through its visible lower depth rail, and drag the visible case handle to rotate the suitcase; keep direct orthogonal probe dragging.
